# Figma → Next.js, 1:1

This project builds pages from Figma with the `figma-page` CLI (from figma-console-mcp). The list of pages lives in `figma.pages.json` at the project root. Reply to the user in their language.

## The loop

1. **Register the page** (once): `figma-page add <name> "<figma link or node id>" <route>`
   - `name`: lowercase-with-dashes; `route`: e.g. `/luyen-de/lam-bai`.
   - The Figma link comes from right-click on the frame → Copy/Paste as → Copy link to selection.
2. **Export from Figma**: `figma-page export <name>` — needs Figma Desktop open with the *Figma Desktop Bridge* plugin running in the right file. Writes `<specDir>/<name>/page-spec.json`, assets and `reference@1x.png`.
3. **Generate code + doc**: `figma-page build <name>` — writes the App Router route, `components/figma/<name>/*` (one component + CSS Module per section), copies assets to `public/figma/<name>/`, and writes `docs/pages/<route>.md`.
4. **Run the app** (`npm run dev` or the project's dev command) and **check**: `figma-page check <name>` (uses `baseUrl` from the config). Exit code 1 means FAIL; read `<specDir>/<name>/fidelity/report.md` and look at `diff.png`.
5. **Fix and repeat** until PASS. `figma-page sync <name>` = export + build.

## Rules

- Files containing `@generated by figma-console-mcp` are regenerated on every build — **never hand-edit them**. To change the result, change the design in Figma (or the hidden per-layer notes below) and rebuild. To take a component over by hand, copy it to a new file without the marker and import that instead.
- The generator refuses to overwrite files it did not write; do not pass `--overwrite` unless the user asks.
- Read `report.md` before changing anything: regions name the Figma node behind each difference. Box differences on text-driven elements up to the text limit (default 2.5px) are font rendering, not layout bugs.
- Spec warnings (section 9 of the page MD) list what CSS cannot reproduce exactly. For such a layer, store `{"export":"png"}` (or `"svg"`) in its hidden notes so it is exported as an image, then sync again.
- Hidden per-layer notes: sharedPluginData namespace `figma_console`, key `spec`, JSON. Viewers never see them. Keys the pipeline reads: `export` ("png" | "svg" | "none"), `scale`, `tag` (HTML tag, e.g. "h1", "header", "button"), `href`, `alt`. Set them with the figma_execute MCP tool, e.g. `node.setSharedPluginData("figma_console", "spec", JSON.stringify({ tag: "h1" }))`.
- `sync` and `check` keep a locked two-line "code note" right under each Figma frame (route, links to the page MD, the code folder and the check report on the repo host, last check result and what is off), visible to everyone without Dev Mode. It is rewritten in place on every run; if it overlaps other layers the command lists them so the team can spread the layout out. Turn off with `"figmaNote": false` or `--no-figma-note`.
- The page MD in `docs/pages/` is the source of truth for anyone (or any AI) rebuilding the page in another stack; keep it generated, not hand-written.

## Commands

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `figma-page list` | Pages in figma.pages.json and whether each has a spec |
| `figma-page add <name> <link\|nodeId> <route>` | Register or update a page |
| `figma-page export [names…]` | Read frames from Figma (all pages if no names) |
| `figma-page build [names…]` | Generate Next.js code + page MD from the specs |
| `figma-page sync [names…]` | export + build |
| `figma-page check [names…] [--base-url URL]` | Pixel + box comparison with Figma; exit 1 on FAIL; updates the code note under the frame |
